reply_text:
*Found two issues to fix before merge* (`upload-extensions` at `a34d0a4` vs `main`):

1. *Extension parsing violates the documented contract* — `src/extension.js:2`
   Uses the second dot-separated segment, without lowercasing. Verified: `archive.tar.gz` and `photo.JPG` fall back to `application/octet-stream`; `photo.jpg.exe` incorrectly returns `image/jpeg`. Names without dots return `undefined` instead of the documented empty string.
   *Fix:* Extract after the last dot, lowercase, and return `''` for missing/trailing extensions. Add regression tests for these cases.

2. *Unknown extensions can return inherited objects/functions instead of MIME strings* — `src/content-type.js:11`
   `TYPES[...]` reads inherited properties: `file.constructor` returns the `Object` function, and `file.__proto__` returns an object, bypassing the fallback.
   *Fix:* Use an own-property check, a null-prototype dictionary, or a `Map`; test prototype-property extensions.

All 3 existing tests pass, but `test/extension.test.js` only covers `photo.jpg`, and there are no `contentType` tests.

No files changed.
